notablePrerequisites: You've gained 3 or more life this turn.
description:
Activate Will by tapping it, reducing the cost of white and/or blue spells you cast this turn by at least {3}.
Activate Midnight Guard by tapping it, adding {W}.
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {W}, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Midnight Guard triggers, untapping Midnight Guard.
Repeat from step 2.
